      Outstanding polo!
      Very happy with this eternally classic polo! The slim in medium fits comfortably and makes for a great look either with trousers, jeans, or shorts. I was a ... More
      Very happy with this eternally classic polo! The slim in medium fits comfortably and makes for a great look either with trousers, jeans, or shorts. I was a bit daring this time and ordered a bold colour, pink sky, to celebrate a new season and a fresh outlook. The fabric is comfortable and two washes have neither faded the colour or altered the fit. One wish, if possible, is to have this colour with a navy blue logo for a more classic finish. Less

        Pictures on the website lead you to believe that the color of the Polo pony is tonal/same color as the shirt. I ordered the navy shirt and the pony is white.         AI Mode replied:

        Yes, Lauren Ralph Lauren (often just called "Lauren") is an official brand and diffusion line owned and operated under the Ralph Lauren Corporation. 
        • What it is: A mid-range, more accessible lifestyle and apparel line primarily focused on women's clothing, accessories, and home goods.
        • Where it is sold: It is widely distributed in major department stores like Macy's.
        • Where it fits: It sits at a more affordable price point compared to high-end labels like the Ralph Lauren Purple Label or the Ralph Lauren Collection.
